Pain points.label: H2
Pain points.text: Spend less time chasing each post

Pain points.label: Body
Pain points.text: WhatsApp threads and email replies make the latest decision hard to find. Give clients one link to review the post and respond.

Pain points.label: Body
Pain points.text: A scheduled time is only part of the job. See publishing failures, understand what went wrong, and follow each retry.

Pain points.label: H3
Pain points.text: Seat costs that complicate your budget

Pain points.label: Body
Pain points.text: Choose a monthly plan with a clear team allowance: one user on Starter or five on Agency. Client reviewers do not need a paid seat.

Features.label: H2
Features.text: From the first draft to the published post

Features.label: Body
Features.text: Organize posts by client brand. Keep each brand’s accounts and content together as you move between workspaces.

Features.label: Body
Features.text: Send a review link. Clients can approve a post or request changes without creating an account.

Features.label: Body
Features.text: See whether a post is scheduled, published, or needs attention. Read errors in plain language and follow retries when a temporary failure can be retried.

Features.label: Note
Features.text: Some errors need your action, such as reconnecting an account. A retry is not a guarantee of publication.

Features.label: Body
Features.text: Plan upcoming posts in a shared view and choose when each one should go out.

Features.label: Body

FAQ.label: Question 1
FAQ.text: What is included in the free trial?

FAQ.label: Answer 1
FAQ.text: The 14-day trial starts in Checkout without a card. Without a payment method, your subscription ends automatically at trial end and you are not charged. If you add a payment method in the customer portal during the trial, billing starts at the displayed price when the trial ends. You can cancel anytime.

FAQ.label: Question 2
FAQ.text: Do I need a credit card?

FAQ.label: Answer 2
FAQ.text: The 14-day trial starts in Checkout without a card. Without a payment method, your subscription ends automatically at trial end and you are not charged. If you add a payment method in the customer portal during the trial, billing starts at the displayed price when the trial ends. You can cancel anytime.

FAQ.label: Answer 3
FAQ.text: Cancel anytime in the customer portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current monthly billing period. There are no partial-period refunds unless required by law.

FAQ.label: Answer 4
FAQ.text: Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram are available today. X, Threads, LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook are planned, subject to platform approval, with no confirmed release dates.

FAQ.label: Question 5
FAQ.text: Does my client need an account to approve posts?

FAQ.label: Answer 5
FAQ.text: No. On Agency, send a review link so your client can approve or request changes without signing in. Keep the link private: anyone with access to it may be able to review the post.

FAQ.label: Question 6
FAQ.text: Is my data hosted in Germany or the EU?

FAQ.label: Answer 6
FAQ.text: SocialMint’s application data is hosted with Hetzner in Germany. Payment processing, optional Google sign-in, and connected social networks may involve processing outside the EU. See our Privacy Policy for details.

FAQ.label: Question 7
FAQ.text: Can I use the API or n8n?

FAQ.label: Answer 7
FAQ.text: Agency includes REST API and webhooks. The n8n node awaits npm publication. Automations use the same brand limits and connected-network permissions as your account.
